    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    markers={}

    rs=[i for i in range(h) if 5 in g[i]]
    cs=[j for j in range(w) if any(g[i][j]==5 for i in range(h))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    rm,cm=(r0+r1)/2,(c0+c1)/2

            if q in quad: grid[i][j]=quad[q]
